# Unify your tech stack with video intelligence

Whether you’re in senior living, multifamily, tech, real‐estate or hospitality, SalesMail becomes a natural part of your existing sales ecosystem, not another tool you have to manage.

![Integration Apps | SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6929d104e10475486391ab91_integration-apps.avif)

## Plug into your CRM & messaging tools

- Works with enterprise-grade systems like Salesforce and HubSpot, as well as niche platforms in senior living and multifamily

- Sends personalized videos via email, SMS, in-CRM triggers, or your existing automated workflows

- One view. One workflow. No need to toggle between platforms.

## Don’t see your integration listed?

No problem! We can create a custom integration for you. Contact our team to learn more.

[Contact us](mailto:mailto:support@salesmail.com)

## Why it matters

- Keeps your sales team and SDRs in “familiar territory” (their CRM), so adoption and results happen faster

- Aligns with your tech stack, giving you full visibility into video-based outreach as part of your funnel analytics

- Supports your vertical specifics. We know what senior living, multifamily, and hospitality sales workflows look like, and our integrations reflect that.


![Why It Matter | SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/69406cafef1067a373fbd3bb_why-it-matter.png)

## Your data, protected at every step

Every conversation, recording, and piece of data you share with us is encrypted in transit and at rest with 256-bit encryption, the same standard used across banking and healthcare. Security isn't a feature we added on, it's how we build everything we ship. We're also currently in the process of completing our SOC 2 certification, further formalizing the security practices our platform is built on.
